from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquityRecord(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company listed in the financial report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code of the company, if available")
    equity_attributable_to_shareholders: float | None = Field(description="Amount of equity attributable to shareholders of the listed company (numeric value)")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit of the equity amount, e.g. 'CNY' or '元'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of the financial statement")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_records: list[CompanyEquityRecord]
